Looping in a few notes from a procurement and ops perspective that will help shape the exec briefing: 

- Procurement path: typical sequence we see — pilot contract (eval credits + limited SLA), security review (evidence + short design review), commercial terms (cap & overage model), then reserved capacity negotiation. We can provide a short sample SOW for the pilot.
- Legal redlines: procurement usually flags data residency and indemnity first. We recommend offering a template amendment for customers wanting an on-prem/private deployment.
- Security/Compliance: Neha, can you prepare the evidence bundle (SOC 2 executive summary, encryption + KMS notes, data handling summary) and a one-page Q&A that addresses the checklist they attached? That will make the panel concise.

Regarding the exec panel content: propose the following 12–15 minute structure — 6 min business objectives & decision criteria; 4 min cost/latency tradeoffs; 4 min security & procurement readiness; 2 min next steps / approval ask. We should keep high-level slides and keep technical detail for the follow-up design review.

I'll draft a simple pilot SOW after Jonas confirms the slot.

—Laura
